summary: JX Luxventure Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of a share exchange agreement dated April 13, 2026, with Dazzly Investment, Inc. and its shareholders. The company acquired 3,500 shares (10% of total outstanding capital stock) of the seller. In exchange, JX Luxventure issued 2,783,046 shares of its common stock, $0.0001 par value, on a pro rata basis. Upon closing, the seller shareholders received 397,578 exchange shares each, and the company now has 12,059,877 common shares outstanding. The shares were issued under Section 4(a)(2) and/or Regulation S exemptions. No financial terms, premium, board recommendation, or advisors were disclosed. Watch for dilution impact and potential integration risks.
